content:
The official 2026 Memorial Day sales at Amazon and Best Buy are now live with today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break headlined by a series of notable deals on the new M4 iPad Air – the 256GB M4 iPad Air Cell model dropping back to the all-time low at $150 off, this mid-range 256GB 13-inch at $110 off, and the most affordable model you can buy down at $520. We also have this 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM at $300 off and Amazon all-time lows returning on the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $150 off, while iPhone Air has also dropped back to all-time low pricing at nearly $150 off for Memorial Day (brand new, unlocked). Head below for a closer look.

Amazon 2026 Memorial Day sale now live at up to 50% off: Apple Watch, MacBook, Galaxy gear, home goods, more

Best Buy launches giant 2026 Memorial Day Sale up to 50% off: TVs, Apple gear, $600 off Android phones, tools, more

New 256GB M4 iPad Air Cell model just dropped back to all-time low at $150 off, more

We are tracking the return of some of the best deals yet on the new M4 iPad Air lineup to start the week off. But if you’re looking for a Wi-Fi + Cell model, you’ll definitely want to have this 11-inch 256GB on your radar – it is now $150 off the list price at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 11-inch 256GB M4 iPad Air Wi-Fi + Cell model down at $799 shipped. This deal is live on all colors outside of the purple variant at the time of writing.

Regularly $849, this configuration is now a straight up $150 off the list price to land on par with the best price we have tracked to date. We saw this same offer live for a couple days back in mid-March before jumping back up to the full $849 list. Fast-forward to today, and we are getting another shot at the Amazon all-time low.

This is, of course, really only a notable deal for folks specifically looking to pickup an always-connected cell config, but if you are, it is a very good one.

If it is the standard Wi-Fi models you’re after, we are also tracking some notable deals across the lineup right now (you’ll see this below), but just make sure you get a good look at these three standout offers first:

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $790 (Reg.$899)

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB $520 (Reg. $599)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB $610 (Reg. $699)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB $834 (Reg. $899)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 1TB $1,019 (Reg. $1,099)

Apple’s mid-range 256GB 13-inch M4 iPad back to Amazon all-time low at nearly $110 off

This 2026 M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM is $300 off the list price right now

Joining a host of ongoing price drops on a range of M5 and M5 Pro MacBook Pro models below, we want to highlight this offer on the 48GB M5 Pro model you can land at $300 off the list price right now.

Amazon has most of the best deals across the current-gen MacBook Pro lineup right now with prices starting down at $1,500 shipped, but if you’re looking for an upgraded 14-inch M5 Pro machine, this B&H deal is definitely worth a look:

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM and a 1TB SSD down at $2,299 shipped. This machine will run you $2,599 at Apple and, because you can’t get this machine from Amazon and some of the big box retailers, you’re not likely to see deals as good as this one very often.

You’re looking at a solid $300 off the list price and a deal that sits among the best we have tracked on the 2026 MacBook releases.

The 48GB setup might be overkill for some folks, but if you are looking towards some serious horsepower, I really like the idea of saving on the storage and display size in favor of the RAM here. Otherwise, scope out the discounts across the lineup below:

M5 MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,500 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,899)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $2,099) – New all-time low

M5 Pro MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,999 (Reg. $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,600 (Reg. $2,799) – Amazon all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,450 (Reg. $2,699) – New all-time low
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,850 (Reg. $3,099) – $50 less at B&H

Amazon all-time lows return on 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $150 off (16 and 24GB models)

After the Amazon all-time lows started to all but entirely disappear last week, we are now once again tracking the $150 price drops on just about all of the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations it offers.

Amazon is now offering the $150 off once again on all three RAM/storage tiers it offers for the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

While there were some $170 price drops on a couple 15-inch Midnight configurations courtesy of B&H that were undercutting these offers by $20 last week, those deals are long gone now. They were only available on a few Midnight configurations and one Sky Blue 13-inch, for the record.

Beyond that and some bundles discounts, these $150 price drops are the lowest we have tracked with this sort of selection and the best Amazon has offered on them. As of right now, only the 15-inch deals have returned – the 13-inch prices are sort of all over the place now but very few of them are available at the $150 off we were tracking early last week.

If its the new MacBook Pro or the late 2025 model you’re after, scope out the deals below instead:

iPhone Air now back to all-time low pricing at nearly $150 off for Memorial Day (Brand new, unlocked)

Apple’s AirTag 4-pack drops to one of its best prices ever at $45 or less ($11 each, Orig. $99)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Anker’s Travel Essentials sale now live at up to 38% off: Bundle deals, FREE gifts, more with deals from just $13
  • Originally $80 Belkin MagSafe 2-in-1 Qi2 15W charging pad down at just $27.50 right now
  • This MagSafe wallet just hit $9.50 with stand functionality and easy ID access (Reg. $20)
  • Bag a spare foldable LISEN Qi2 3-in-1 charging station for just $14.50 (Save 67%)
  • Belkin’s latest 9,300mAh wireless charging camera grip with MagSafe/Pixelsnap support is down to just $66 today
  • Insta360’s 2026 Memorial Day sale now live at up to $120 off: Ace Pro 2 8K cam, GO Ultra, X5 action cam, more, deals from $40

One of the best Apple Watch Series 11 deals is back: 46mm at $130 off

Arguably one of the best Apple Watch Series 11 deals we have tracked yet has now returned. While we are seeing deeper deals on the pricey Titanium variants, Amazon is once again offering the $130 price drop on the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell models.

Amazon has all four case colors of the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model sitting back down at $399 shipped. The smaller and less pricey 42mm model is actually sitting at the same price right now (that one is $100 off its list price).

This is a $529 configuration seeing a solid $130 price drop to bring it back down to the lowest price we have ever tracked. We saw this same Series 11 configuration drop to $459 for Black Friday last year, and then down to the previous low at $429 ahead of the holidays and a couple times this year. But at $130 off, you’re looking at the lowest price we have tracked to date at Amazon.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $499)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell $399 (Reg. $529)

As seen above, you will still find a limited selection of 42mm GPS-only models starting from $299 and the $100 price drops on the same 46mm model are all still live starting from $329 if you don’t want the Cell connectivity option. But the 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell is clearly the standout deal here, and it is now back for the taking.
